id: \bHau: Alola! I just got done with a match against Nanu. I could always go for more.
en: \bHau: Alola! I just got done with a match against Nanu. I could always go for more.
it: \bHau: Alola! Ho appena finito una sfida contro Nanu. Ma ne farei volentieri un'altra.

id: \rSo I guess we do this now?
en: \rSo I guess we do this now?

id: \rOh you talked to me again!? Most people walk off without even saying thank you.
en: \rOh you talked to me again!? Most people walk off without even saying thank you.
it: \rOh, mi hai parlato di nuovo!? La maggior parte della gente se ne va senza nemmeno dire grazie.

id: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
en: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?

id: \bYou didn't hear it from me, but apparently Nanu is friends with a crime boss from Kanto! A crime boss! Nanu is a former cop too.
en: \bYou didn't hear it from me, but apparently Nanu is friends with a crime boss from Kanto! A crime boss!  Nanu is a former cop too.
it: \bNon te l'ho detto io, ma pare che Nanu sia amico di un boss criminale di Kanto! Un boss criminale!  E Nanu è pure un ex poliziotto.

id: \bI don't know what you're doing in this run down town but I suggest you go back to where you came from.
en: \bI don't know what you're doing in this run down town but I suggest you go back to where you came from.
it: \bNon so cosa ci fai in questa città in rovina, ma ti consiglio di tornartene da dove sei venuto.

id: \rAcerola: Woah, hold on! The desert ahead is scary. You really shouldn't go in there.
en: \rAcerola: Woah, hold on! The desert ahead is scary.  You really shouldn't go in there.
it: \rAcerola: Ehi, aspetta! Il deserto più avanti fa paura.  Non dovresti proprio entrarci.
